vibe: Academic, rigorous, sustainable, archival, trustworthy. A specialized Organic & Earthy mixed with Swiss Typography.

typography.hierarchy_rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Max H1 size is text-5xl sm:text-6xl+. Body text text-base. Overlines MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]). NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

colors.rules: Never use pure black or white. Tint neutral greys with warm stone tones. Terracotta (#B95438) used strictly for key CTAs and alerts.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-24 for sections. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Asymmetric grids. Consider a visible grid/archival look (border-collapse style). 1px borders between columns. Do not center everything.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical left-alignment for paragraphs and forms. Tension over perfect symmetry.

components.navbar: Glassmorphism with warm stone tint (bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl), sharp 1px bottom border border-[#D1CEC7]. Navigation must be visible on desktop.
components.hero: Hero layout should be asymmetric. Overlay must not be a flat dark blanket. Use subtle gradient to transparent, or keep image adjacent to text. High impact typography.
components.team_card: No shadows. 1px solid border (#D1CEC7). Grayscale or muted photos. Clean, dense text at bottom. Archival card look. Use pure HTML + Tailwind.
components.gallery_masonry: True masonry layout. Gap-4 or gap-6. Lightbox support. Minimal UI overlays on images.
components.contact_form: Shadcn components heavily customized. Square corners (rounded-none), 1px solid borders, earthy active ring color.
components.admin_dashboard: Dense, functional, pure Shadcn but flat. No rounded corners. Compact spacing. Sharp edges, cardless or max 8px border-radius.
components.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp transitions. Borders darken on hover. Text color explicitly set on hover. No excessive scaling.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Subtle entrance animations, staggered fade-in for lists/gallery. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

hero.description: Scientist in modern lab setting. Good for abstract hero background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full-stack application using FastAPI (backend) and React + Tailwind (frontend). STRICTLY follow the design rules in this JSON. Do not use generic Inter/Roboto fonts, use Spectral for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Do not use center-heavy layouts; rely on asymmetric bento grids and visible grid lines for an 'archival/library' look. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections (Home, Team, Gallery). Use Shadcn ONLY for interactive logic (Forms, Admin Dashboard) and heavily customize Shadcn to have sharp corners (rounded-none) and earthy active states. Build the CRUD for Team/Gallery via FastAPI and secure the admin panel at a secret URL.
